verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels remain off across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at zero spend, generating no paid leads. Your Google Business Profile activity carried all measurable engagement — 401 combined actions across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, including 23 calls, 257 direction requests, and 121 website clicks in the last 28 days. O'Hare Precision is the strongest performer with 203 GBP actions and 413 organic search clicks, while Forte Metals saw a significant 76.92% week-over-week surge in profile engagement. Advance Grinding's GBP engagement softened 16.67% over the last seven days, which we are monitoring closely as paid support is not currently in place to offset any organic dip. Restarting paid campaigns across locations remains the clearest path to generating trackable leads.
